title: Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Dominican Republic Foreign Minister Bisonó Haza
summary_raw:
Office of the Spokesman
Readout


			
			


			
			
October 16, 2026

Secretary of State Marco Rubio met today with Dominican Republic Foreign Minister Víctor Bisonó Haza in Washington to advance the strong U.S.–Dominican Republic partnership.  The two discussed deepening security cooperation against the cartels and narco-terrorist groups that threaten our hemisphere.  They also discussed continued collaboration under the U.S.–Dominican Republic Critical Minerals Framework to advance concrete investment in the mining sector.
